old_case.relationship: Unresolved identification of the reproached exchange
old_case.rationale: The psalm speaks of enemies reproaching the exchange of the anointed, an expression not resolved by its context. Matthew records abuse of Jesus and mockery of His claim as King of Israel, but does not explain that exchange. An identification of the psalmic event with this Passion scene is therefore unretained.
